text:
Lia: Quick heads up — planning an experiment tomorrow to move EU-west from strict burst-cap (2x steady) to a proportional reserve model. Goal: reduce steady-state wasted reserved GPUs while keeping p99 latency tail under 500ms. Details in thread.

Mike: what's the expected GPU-hours delta? any cost forecasts?

Lia: Rough sketch: forecasted GPU-hours down ~9-12% on normal weekdays, spike up max 6% during promo if reserve triggers. Baseline is last 6 weeks of traffic + holiday uplift. I'll paste the proposed policy snippet.

Lia: ```yaml
policy:
  mode: proportional_reserve
  reserve_percent: 0.15
  burst_multiplier: 2.2
  cooldown_s: 180
  max_reserve_gpus: 40
  per_az_enforce: true
```

Anita: important callout — we should protect KV cache behaviour. Last time we let reserves drop too low during evictions and p99 jumped. Recommend a soft floor of 10 GPUs per AZ and a fallback to a smaller quantized model when cache miss rate > 8%.

Jordan: finance flagged EU credits; if we overshoot we need an auto-throttle path that switches traffic to preemptible-backed pools + throttle non-critical embeddings. Suggest adding `budget_guard: true` and `fallback_model: quant-small` to the config.

autoscale-bot: deploy/scale-policy started for cluster eu-west-1. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/autoscale?orgId=1 (alerts enabled).

Mike: add these alert hooks into the rollout plan:
- p95 token latency > 300ms sustained 3m -> immediate rollback
- GPU utilization peak > 92% for 5m -> pause proportional increases and notify oncall
- burst_count > 5/day -> auto-reduce burst_multiplier by 0.1 and submit ticket to eng-infra

Anita: can we canary to a single AZ (eu-west-1a) at 5% traffic first? That'll let us validate KV/cache and preemptible mixing without global blast radius.

Lia: Yes — proposed plan: canary 48h at 5% -> evaluate metrics -> ramp to 25% -> full. Success criteria: p99 < 500ms, error delta <= +0.05%, burst_count within expected band. If any critical alert fires -> instant rollback and notify #incidents.

Jordan: I'll notify finance to provision a small temporary buffer for EU credits for the week of the experiment. Lia, can you paste the short runbook here so SRE/oncall has steps?

Lia: Runbook (short):
1) set autoscale policy back to stable: `redwoodctl autoscale set --policy stable`
2) if rollback needed: `redwoodctl autoscale rollback --cluster eu-west-1` then `kubectl scale --replicas=<safe>` on inference pools
3) Pager -> @oncall-sre and @eng-platform, include grafana link and last 60m token latency graph
4) If budget guard tripped, finance fallback kicks in and preemptible pool takes overflow; open ticket to finance@redwood.com
5) Fill postmortem template: https://confluence.internal/x/Yz12

Lia: tagging: @Mike @Anita @Jordan :thumbsup: Next sync 09:00 UTC tomorrow to kick off.
